Molly Tea Opens at Hillion Mall: 1-for-1 Top 6 Drinks and Free Tumblers, 9-11 Oct 2026

Molly Tea, the Shenzhen jasmine milk tea chain, opens its third Singapore store and first in the West at Hillion Mall B1, by Bukit Panjang MRT. The campaign runs in three stages: 12% off its top six drinks during the soft opening (6-8 Oct), buy 1 get 1 free on the same six for the grand opening (9-11 Oct) with a daily gift for the first 250 customers (tumbler, candle or fridge magnet), and a free fragrance disc with any two drinks from 12 to 18 Oct, capped at 100 a day. Gifts are while stocks last and in-store terms apply.

PlayMade 1-for-1 Reopening Special at Westgate & Waterway Point: 5 Drinks From $2.10 a Cup, 2 & 3 October Only

PlayMade has reopened its Westgate and Waterway Point outlets with the brand's new PlayMade, Remade look, and is running 1-for-1 on five featured drinks on 2 and 3 October 2026 at those two outlets only. All five are medium and iced: Chrysanthemum Milk Tea, Dong Ding Oolong Milk Tea and Taiwan Milk Tea are $4.20 for the pair, Osmanthus Oolong Tea $4.50 and Honey Queen Jasmine Green Tea $4.80, which works out to $2.10 to $2.40 a cup. Mixed pairs are charged at the higher price, toppings cost extra, and it runs while stocks last. A Protein Smoothie Series and the brand's first merchandise line follow at all stores on 9 October.

Tofu G $2 Toppings Bar: Pile On All 12 Toppings With Any Gelato at Suntec City and Waterway Point

Korean tofu-gelato brand Tofu G has a self-serve toppings bar at its two newest outlets, Suntec City #B1-K5 and Waterway Point #01-53. Add $2 to any gelato and take as much as fits in the cup from 12 toppings: injeolmi, joripong, yakgwa, puffed rice, tempeh chips, five kinds of nuts, dried cranberries and marshmallow. With an $8 scoop, a fully loaded cup comes to $10. No end date has been published, and the bar is not at Tofu G's four other outlets.

KFC Gen B Buffet: Unlimited O.R. Tenders and Chicken Bites for $25.95 at KFC *SCAPE, Fri 16 Oct 2026

KFC Singapore is running a one-day, all-you-can-eat Gen B Buffet at KFC *SCAPE on Friday 16 October 2026, with two 90-minute sessions at 5pm and 7pm. A $25.95 ticket covers unlimited O.R. Tenders, Hot & Crispy Chicken Bites, Whipped Potato and fountain drinks, plus a free-flow sauce bar with O.R. Gravy and five sauces including the new Seoul Spicy and Chipotle Honey Mustard. Buy two or more tickets and KFC takes 10% off (about $23.36 a head). Tickets are sold only on KFC's online merch store, are non-refundable, and buffet diners can opt into a Tenders eating challenge that pays $5 a Tender, capped at 100.

Sushiro Hougang Mall Opens With Rotating 1-for-1 Sushi and $1.50++ Free-Flow Drinks (1-14 Oct 2026)

Sushiro's newest Singapore outlet opens today, Thursday 1 October 2026, at Hougang Mall #02-23/24, and for its first two weeks one premium sushi at a time goes 1-for-1. Bluefin Fatty Tuna leads at $4.90++ for two pieces (usually $9.80++) on 1 and 2 October, followed by salmon belly with ikura, grilled eel, medium fatty tuna, big red shrimp and big cut fresh salmon, each for two or three days to 14 October. The free-flow drinks bar and green tea are $1.50++ instead of $3.00++ for the whole fortnight. The catch is printed on Sushiro's own poster: the two pieces are served together on one plate, so it is a half-price double plate rather than a voucher, and prices are before 10% service charge and 9% GST.
